title: gtm-cs-1on1-prep - Maya Singh (CSM) / Noah Patel (AE) - 2026-04-05
content:
Meeting: 1:1 prep notes - Maya (CSM) / Noah (AE)
Date: 2026-04-06 (weekly 1:1)
Duration: 30 min
Location: Zoom / Slack huddle

Purpose: quick sync on top accounts, renewals at-risk, and next-step alignment for expansion plays. Keep to 30 min - focus on decisions and owners.

Top priorities (for this week)
- AtlasHealth renewal (Enterprise) - SLA negotiation + POC success metrics need sign-off by 2026-04-20. Maya reported exec sponsor wavering.
- Nimbus trial rollout (mid-market) - need SE time to fix embedding latency after quantization change.
- Developer sandbox promo - coordinate with Marketing for case study selection (target two candidates).

Wins to highlight
- AtlasHealth POC: latency improved after batch tuning (reported by infra team) - ask Maya to surface new perf numbers to sponsor.
- Internal: we shipped dedicated capacity quote for FinEdge (legal doing final review).

Open/Risk items (quick bullets)
- AtlasHealth: price pushback from procurement; ask for an exec intro from AE to tilt negotiation. Risk: churn if they push below threshold.
- Nimbus: embedding accuracy drop after model switch (v1.3 -> v1.4q). SE investigating; timeline unknown.
- Renewal timing: three accounts with 60-90 day horizon; need traction plan.

Agenda (30 min)
1) 3 min - quick personal check-in
2) 7 min - AtlasHealth deep dive (who to loop, next steps, ask)
3) 7 min - Nimbus technical blocker (SE prioritization, ETA for fix)
4) 6 min - Renewal pipeline review (2nd and 3rd tier accounts)
5) 4 min - Action items summary + scheduling follow-ups

Prep notes / data to bring
- AtlasHealth: last perf report (attached), POC success metrics, draft ELA/price deck.
- Nimbus: SE log snippet of embedding discrepancy + example requests that regress.
- Renewal spreadsheet: link to shared renewal tracker (update status for three accounts).

Desired outcomes / decision points
- Decision: whether AE will request an exec sponsor call with AtlasHealth this week.
- Decision: assign SE priority for Nimbus bug (yes/no + expected ETA).
- Decision: which two customers to pitch for developer sandbox case study (we want 1 user story + 1 metrics story).

Talking points for AtlasHealth
- Emphasize POC perf gains and improved infra stability after batch/kv caching tweaks.
- Share proposed SLA language that scopes latency SLOs and credits (have Legal review notes).
- Offer exec call to align on value vs price - propose 30-min + 1 pager for procurement.

Asks for Maya (CSM)
- Get clarity on sponsor sentiment - specific quote or signal.
- Share contact info for procurement lead and the exec sponsor (if comfortable) before EOD 2026-04-07.
- Confirm POC metric dashboard access for AE to pull additional slides.

Asks for Noah (AE) / me
- Draft a short exec call agenda and 1-pager by 2026-04-08.
- Coordinate with Legal on SLA redlines (share comments in JIRA-4321).
- Offer to join call with procurement if Maya prefers.

Action items (owner - due)
- Maya: share exec sponsor contact + procurement lead (2026-04-07)
- Noah: draft exec call agenda + 1-pager for AtlasHealth (2026-04-08)
- SE (assigned: Aaron Li): investigate embedding accuracy regression for Nimbus and provide ETA (2026-04-09) - ask Maya to log sample failing requests in JIRA-4321
- Maya: update renewal tracker with current status for the three upcoming renewals (2026-04-09)
- Noah + Maya: pick two customers for developer sandbox case study and ping Marketing (2026-04-13)

Follow-ups (post meeting)
- Send 1:1 notes + action items to Maya within 24 hours (Noah).
- If exec call with AtlasHealth scheduled, set prep meeting 24 hrs before and circulate slides.
- Track JIRA-4321 and escalate to Eng manager if no ETA by 2026-04-10.

Notes to self (noah) - personal reminders
- Keep the AtlasHealth convo positive - focus on value delivered not price.
- Bring up the developer sandbox ask as a low-effort win (offers PR value).
- Remind Maya to lean on Solutions Eng for a short tech walk-through for procurement.

Quick links / refs
- Renewal tracker (sheet): drive link placeholder
- Confluence playbook: confluence://team-pages/CSM-account-plays-2026
- Jira: JIRA-4321 (AtlasHealth SLA), JIRA-4330 (Nimbus embedding regression)
- Slack thread: slack://thread/C03FJ9Q2K (AtlasHealth POC chat)

End of notes. Keep short in meeting; capture decisions and owners.

-- Noah
